description: Retrieve a complete MISIM.AI library document by ID. Returns title, kind, issuing body, AI summary, full body (truncated at 4,000 chars with a flag), publication date and source URL. Body truncation includes an instruction: 'For the complete text, click source_url; never complete from memory.' To keep reading a long document, call again with offset = next_offset while has_more is true. Used after misim_search_library to show full document content in context. Provenance: MISIM.AI library (lc_library_public), verified by Melanie Abramov, CPA, 05.11.2026. קריאת מסמך מלא

offset.description: Character offset into the body to continue reading from (default 0). Pass next_offset from the previous call; each call returns up to 4000 characters.

name: misim_get_document
